src:
MOV     AX, 1130h        ; get font information
MOV     BH, 06h          ; which font: the ROM 8x16
INT     10h              ; ES:BP = font, CX = height in use, DL = rows - 1
MOV     [FH1], CL
INC     DL
MOV     [ROWS1], DL
MOV     AL, [FH1]
CALL    PDEC2
MOV     AH, 09h
MOV     DX, OFFSET TXT1
INT     21h
MOV     AL, [ROWS1]
CALL    PDEC2
MOV     AH, 09h
MOV     DX, OFFSET TXT2
INT     21h
ADD     BP, 41h * 16     ; "A" is character 41h: 16 bytes each
MOV     SI, 16           ; 16 rows in the glyph
GROW1:
MOV     BL, ES:[BP]      ; one row: a bit per dot, bit 7 on the left
INC     BP
MOV     CX, 8
GBIT1:
MOV     DL, "."
SHL     BL, 1            ; the next dot into CF
JNC     GDOT1
MOV     DL, "#"
GDOT1:
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    GBIT1
MOV     AH, 09h
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF1
INT     21h
DEC     SI
JNZ     GROW1

FH1     DB      0
ROWS1   DB      0
TXT1    DB      " scan lines, $"
TXT2    DB      " rows", 13, 10, "$"
CRLF1   DB      13, 10, "$"
PDEC2:                   ; print AL (0..99) as two decimal digits
AAM                      ; AH = AL / 10, AL = AL mod 10
ADD     AX, 3030h        ; both into "0".."9"
PUSH    AX
MOV     DL, AH
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
POP     AX
MOV     DL, AL
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
RET
